instruction: Add the current tab to my bookmarks bar.

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding the current tab (Illustrated Transformer page) to bookmarks bar. Uses existing is_expected_bookmarks metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Ambiguous 'current tab': The instruction says 'current tab' but doesn't specify which of the two open tabs (Rotary Embeddings or Illustrated Transformer). The evaluator assumes it's the Illustrated Transformer tab, but at runtime the Rotary Embeddings tab could be active.
Non-deterministic verification: The evaluator's expected value doesn't match the ambiguous instruction - success depends on which tab happens to be active at execution time.
Semantic mismatch: A correct execution of the instruction (bookmarking whichever tab is currently active) could fail evaluation if the 'wrong' tab was active.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Make instruction specific: Change to 'Add the tab showing The Illustrated Transformer to my bookmarks bar' or specify by URL/tab position (e.g., 'Add the second tab to bookmarks')
OR: Make evaluator dynamic - extract the actual active tab URL first (using get_active_url_from_accessTree), then verify that specific URL was bookmarked
OR: Accept either URL as valid - check that bookmark count increased by 1 and one of the two initial URLs is present in bookmarks
